lines.trans: Andrea, we have a big problem with the casting.
What is going on with the film?
I made a huge mistake.
Bassem is not Baptiste.
What do you mean? Baptiste is forty-five years old!
Yes, it is a very important role.
He is the main partner of Gerard Lanvin.
But how could you confuse the two?
The two first names sound too much alike.
Did you try calling Mathias?
Yes, I reached his voicemail.
We must find a solution right away.
I am going to try to fix my mistake.
Hurry up, the casting is starting now.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
with numbers: huit ans, vingt ans

meanings.note: dire des bêtises = to talk nonsense / say rude things

examples.text: Elle me veut pour le casting!
examples.trans: She wants me for the casting!

meanings.en: casting, audition process (for a film or play)

as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Elles commencent avec un peu de Botox.
examples.trans: They start with a bit of Botox.

meanings.en: commencer par / avec: to start with

meanings.note: comment ça va? = how are you?

examples.text: Vous confondez vie privée et vie professionnelle.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: to hurry, to rush; se dépêcher = to hurry up

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

before the noun: un gros contrat
